seoDescription: Iredell-Statesville Schools starts Aug. 12, 2026. See 2026–27 spring and winter break dates, no-school days, early releases, official PDFs, and ICS download.
heroSummary: Iredell-Statesville Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and the last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Students are out of school from Dec. 21 through Jan. 4 and return Tuesday, Jan. 5. The March 8–12 spring break period is marked as Annual Leave on the district calendar.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26?
whatsNew.subtitle: A comparison of the two official district calendar files.
content: The first student day moves from Aug. 11 to Aug. 12, while the last student day moves from May 22 to May 27.
The spring break planning range shifts from Mar. 9–13 to Mar. 8–12.
All six traditional-school early-release dates for professional development change in 2026–27. They are Sept. 23, Nov. 4, Dec. 2, Feb. 17, Apr. 7, and May 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Iredell-Statesville Schools calendar should my student follow?
calendarFaqs.a: Most students use the district's 2026–27 calendar. That PDF lists different early-release dates for professional development at traditional schools and Early Colleges. N.B. Mills Elementary has a separate official calendar linked on this page.

calendarFaqs.q: Are I-SS teacher workdays no-school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Students do not attend school on the teacher workdays and required teacher workdays printed on the 2026–27 calendar. Check I-SS after weather closures in case the district revises the schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When do I-SS students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, Jan. 5, 2027. MySchoolDates groups the teacher workdays, annual leave, and holidays from Dec. 21 through Jan. 4 as a winter break planning range.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the I-SS calendar download update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import and does not sync with later district revisions. Download a new file if I-SS changes the published calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check after an I-SS weather closure?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official I-SS calendar page and messages from your child's school. Weather closures or district decisions can change workdays, no-school dates, and return dates.
